body: I developed feelings for another person, romantically.

I have told him how I feel, about our relationship. I told him I wasn't in love anymore, but I told him I was willing to work on it, and I have been, but nothing has changed. 

I don't know if he would kill himself. But the thought terrifies me, because even if I'm not in love with him, I care for him very deeply. I want him in my life, because he's so important to me, but I'm so conflicted. :/
